inflation.rationale: Hot headline, cooling core: US CPI 3.4% y/y (Aug 2026) with +0.4% m/m led by war-driven gasoline, core down to 2.4%; 1-yr expectations up to 3.9% and IMF lifted 2026 global inflation to ~4.7% on a ~41% oil surge, with the Sep CPI print due Oct 14 the market's focal event.

rates.rationale: Hiking, not cutting: the Fed raised 25bp on 2026-09-16 to 3.75-4.00% (first hike since 2023, 12-0 vote) and markets price December hike risk into the Oct 27-28 FOMC; hawkish Fedspeak (Hammack: restrictive policy 'relatively quickly') and 10-year yields near 2007 highs.

geopolitics.rationale: War dominates headlines: the 2026 Iran war escalates (US weighing 'major combat operations', partial Strait of Hormuz closure) while Trump's Oct 11 Ukraine energy ceasefire was violated within a day, the Kremlin rejects interim truces, and the EU imposed new sanctions.

ai_tech.rationale: The AI trade is cracking: a global chip rout on Oct 13 (Broadcom 'casino' remark, Korea -6%, Nasdaq in correction territory, Nvidia ~-11% and Broadcom ~-12% in recent sessions) after ECB dot-com-level valuation warnings, though semis remain up ~62% YTD.

energy.rationale: Acute stress: Brent topped ~$105 (Oct 8) on Iran-war escalation with the Hormuz partially closed and a global diesel squeeze (UK pump prices at a record ~£2/litre); EIA now sees 2026 Brent averaging ~$98 and the IMF ~$96 (oil +~41% YTD).

em_stress.rationale: Regional, not systemic: Brazil's Bovespa hit records with the real firm and Selic cutting, but India's RBI is defending the rupee near 97 (reserves down ~$13bn) as DXY rose ~2% in Sep and the IMF warns oil shocks hit EM inflation roughly twice as hard.

gold_rally.rationale: Elevated but off the peak: spot gold ~$4,170/oz (Oct 13), ~25% below the January all-time high of ~$5,589 as a hawkish Fed and strong dollar weigh, yet record Chinese imports and war hedging keep a floor under safe-haven demand.
